secs: Send your suitcase to the hotel

Kuma Travel offers a luggage delivery service (paid, advance booking required) that brings your suitcases from Incheon Airport to your hotel in Seoul. The price depends on the number of bags and the destination, so we send you a quote via LINE.
Hand over your bags and head straight to the sights by train. Your luggage reaches the hotel front desk before check-in.
If you would like to send luggage from your hotel to the airport on your departure day, just ask.
Store your bags at Incheon Airport
Terminals 1 and 2 at Incheon Airport both have paid baggage storage, handy during a layover or for some last-minute sightseeing on your departure day.

If you and your bags are traveling together anyway, a transfer (KRW 150,000 to central Seoul, 1 vehicle) can be simpler and cheaper overall. A Staria fits 4–5 large suitcases, and a Solati takes 15 or more.

Common questions: Incheon Airport to central Seoul

Many people search by hotel, with queries like sending luggage to a hotel, from a hotel, Incheon Airport hotels and luggage to the hotel. Whatever your hotel, just send us its name or address and we will take you to the front entrance.
For international flights, plan to be at Incheon Airport 2–3 hours before departure. Security gets crowded during the morning departure rush and on holiday weekends, so we recommend arriving early.

On cost alone, the train (AREX airport railroad and subway) is cheapest, followed by the airport limousine bus and then taxis. A transfer, however, is KRW 150,000 split among your group, so 4 travelers sharing the vehicle pay KRW 37,500 each.
faq: How much is a taxi from Incheon Airport to central Seoul?

Regular taxis are metered, and a ride to Seoul City Hall costs roughly KRW 57,000–71,000 (estimate based on fares as of November 2026). A surcharge applies from 22:00 to 4:00. The Kuma Travel transfer is a flat KRW 150,000 (Staria up to 6 passengers, price for 1 vehicle) and does not change with the time of day or traffic.
How long does it take by car from Incheon Airport to central Seoul?
With no traffic, plan on about 54 minutes from Terminal 1 (54.5km) and about 55 minutes from Terminal 2 (59.8km). Morning and evening rush hours and weekend afternoons can take longer.
Can I get from central Seoul to Incheon Airport in time for an early-morning flight?

Yes. We can arrange pickups before the first train runs. For a 7:00 flight, for example, plan to leave central Seoul around 2:40. We work backward from your flight and road conditions to suggest a pickup time.
Where do we meet at Incheon Airport?

At both Terminals 1 and 2, we wait at the arrivals hall exit on the 1st floor holding a sign with your name. Korean Air and some other airlines arrive at Terminal 2, so please give us your flight number when you book.
Can we ride to central Seoul with lots of large suitcases?
A Staria fits 4–5 large suitcases, and a Solati takes 15 or more. Regular taxis have small trunks that can be full with just 2 bags.

secs: Getting to the International Terminal

Gimpo Airport Station (subway Lines 5 and 9 and the AREX airport railroad) is closer to the Domestic Terminal, and you reach the International Terminal through an underground walkway. With lots of luggage, the walk can feel a little long.
Flights from Japan, such as from Haneda, Kansai and Nagoya, use the International Terminal. By taxi or transfer, you can get in and out right in front of the International Terminal.
With a transfer

Kuma Travel's Gimpo Airport transfer is a flat KRW 80,000 to central Seoul (Staria up to 6 passengers, 1 vehicle). The price stays the same late at night, early in the morning and in traffic, and a round-trip booking gets 10% off (Gimpo Airport ⇄ central Seoul is KRW 80,000 one way).

Domestic connections and spending time at the airport

If you are connecting to a domestic flight to Jeju or Busan, clear immigration and collect your bags at the International Terminal, then move to the Domestic Terminal and check in again. You can walk between them, but it takes time with lots of luggage, so plan with plenty of margin.

Next to the airport is Lotte Mall Gimpo Airport, handy for shopping or a meal before your flight home. If you have time before departure, leave your bags at the hotel or the airport storage first and drop by unburdened.

Conversely, if you fly into Gimpo Airport on a domestic flight from Jeju or elsewhere and then fly home to Japan, you walk from the Domestic Terminal to the International Terminal. Allow at least 2 hours for the connection in case the domestic flight is delayed.

The International Terminal's departures hall is smaller than Incheon Airport's, and the walk from check-in to the gate is short. Even so, security gets crowded around holiday periods, so arriving 2 hours before departure gives you peace of mind.

gmp-walkerhill-taxi.title: Gimpo Airport to Walkerhill Taxi Fares and Times｜Flat-Rate Transfer KRW 80,000｜Kuma Travel
gmp-walkerhill-taxi.desc: Hilltop hotels above the Han River (Grand Walkerhill, Vista Walkerhill), far from stations. Taxi fares and times from Gimpo Airport. 35.0km, about 45 min.
gmp-walkerhill-taxi.h1: How Much Is a Taxi from Gimpo Airport to Walkerhill?
gmp-walkerhill-taxi.lead: A hilltop hotel area overlooking the Han River (Grand Walkerhill and Vista Walkerhill), some distance from the nearest station. Here are the fares, travel times and taxi stands for getting between Walkerhill and Gimpo Airport by taxi.
box: KRW 80,000 (flat rate, 1 vehicle), same price late at night and early morning
secs: Estimated taxi fares from Gimpo Airport to Walkerhill

The road distance from the International Terminal to Grand Walkerhill is 35.0km. The route from Gimpo Airport to Walkerhill is mostly on regular city roads, so the taxi fare is much lower than from Incheon Airport. A regular taxi to Walkerhill should run about KRW 33,000–42,000 on the meter (estimate based on fares as of November 2026 and road distance).

From 22:00 to 4:00, a late-night surcharge (20–40% depending on the hour) applies. Walkerhill sits on a hill, so walking from the nearest station is not realistic. Going directly from the airport to the hotel's drop-off area is by far the easiest.

The Kuma Travel transfer is a flat KRW 80,000, unchanged late at night, early in the morning or in traffic. 4 travelers sharing the vehicle pay KRW 20,000 each, which can be cheaper than splitting into 2 taxis.
Regular taxi vs. flat-rate transfer
A regular taxi's trunk is full with about 2 suitcases. If 4 adults with lots of luggage are heading to Walkerhill, you will need a jumbo taxi or a van transfer.

At Gimpo Airport, the taxi stand is close to the arrivals hall and waits tend to be short. With a transfer, we meet you at the arrivals hall exit and walk you straight to the car. Walkerhill sits on a hill, so walking from the nearest station is not realistic. Going directly from the airport to the hotel's drop-off area is by far the easiest.
Recommendations by situation

Late or early：There are few ways to get out from the hotel at night, so if you plan to go out, a taxi or chartered car is the convenient choice. With a transfer, we wait for your flight, and the price is the same as during the day.
Group travel：A Staria seats 6 passengers plus 4–5 large suitcases. 4 travelers sharing the vehicle pay KRW 20,000 each.
Family trip：Even with a stroller or large bags, we help carry your luggage from the Gimpo Airport arrivals hall to the car.
Traveling light：Take subway Line 5 to Gwangnaru Station, then the hotel shuttle bus. The train is the cheapest option.
Estimated hotel arrival by flight time

From Gimpo Airport, the route exits on the east side of the airport and heads to Walkerhill via roads such as Gangbyeonbuk-ro (north of the Han River). Much of the way is off the expressway, so time spent at traffic lights largely decides the travel time.
9:00 arrival：at your Walkerhill hotel around 11:00
13:00 arrival：at your Walkerhill hotel around 15:00
17:00 arrival：at your Walkerhill hotel around 19:00
21:00 arrival：at your Walkerhill hotel around 22:40
23:00 arrival：at your Walkerhill hotel around 0:40
Estimates allow about 50 minutes for immigration and baggage claim, with daytime driving times multiplied by 1.4 for traffic.
About the Walkerhill area

A hilltop hotel area overlooking the Han River (Grand Walkerhill and Vista Walkerhill), some distance from the nearest station. Major hotels include Grand Walkerhill Seoul and Vista Walkerhill Seoul. If your group is split across several hotels around Walkerhill, we can drop everyone off in turn.
Drop-off tip：Walkerhill sits on a hill, so walking from the nearest station is not realistic. Going directly from the airport to the hotel's drop-off area is by far the easiest.

Hotel
Drop-off at the front entrance. These hotels overlook the Han River and suit a relaxed stay enjoying the in-house restaurants and shows.

icn-magok-ikikata.h1: Incheon Airport to Magok｜Which Way Is Easiest?
icn-magok-ikikata.lead: Which way gets you from Incheon Airport to Magok without changing? We compare each transport option on this 44.3km road route.
box: KRW 150,000 (flat rate, 1 vehicle), same price late at night and early morning
secs: 4 ways to get from Incheon Airport to Magok
Rail, direct：The AREX airport railroad stops at Magongnaru Station, so you can get there with no transfers.
Limousine bus：Direct airport limousine bus routes to Magok are limited, so the train or a taxi is easier.
Taxi：Board at the taxi stand right outside the arrivals hall. Expect about KRW 49,000–60,000 (estimate based on fares as of November 2026, late-night surcharge extra).
Transfer：No changes from the arrivals hall exit to your hotel entrance. The price is a flat KRW 150,000 (1 vehicle). Magok is a new district with wide roads, just a short drive from Gimpo Airport.
How to choose

Late or early：At night Magok is a quiet mix of offices and homes, ideal if you want a calm stay near the airport. With a transfer, we wait for your flight, and the price is the same as during the day.
Lots of luggage：Magok is a new district with wide roads, just a short drive from Gimpo Airport.
Family trip：Even with a stroller or large bags, we help carry your luggage from the Incheon Airport arrivals hall to the car.
Traveling light：The AREX airport railroad stops at Magongnaru Station, so you can get there with no transfers. The train is the cheapest option.
Estimated hotel arrival by flight time

From Incheon Airport, the route crosses Yeongjong Bridge or Incheon Bridge and enters Seoul via the Incheon International Airport Expressway. For Magok, it usually continues along Olympic-daero (south of the Han River), detouring onto city streets when the riverside road is congested.
9:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 10:50
13:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 14:50
17:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 18:50
21:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 22:40
23:00 arrival：at your Magok hotel around 0:40
Estimates allow about 50 minutes for immigration and baggage claim, with daytime driving times multiplied by 1.4 for traffic.
About the Magok area

A new district just east of Gimpo Airport, home to Seoul Botanic Park, the Mayfield Hotel and LG Science Park. Highlights include Seoul Botanic Park, Magongnaru Station and Balsan Station. Nearby areas are Yeongdeungpo (about 9.1km), Hongdae (about 8.6km) and Yeouido (about 9.9km).
On arrival day：Relax on arrival day with the greenhouse and a lakeside walk at Seoul Botanic Park.
